subject: How do you add an update button in html?

messages.author: 7befd1c701df2fda
messages.subject: How do you add an update button in html?
parts:
Hey guys,
I totally fall in love with Shiny to be honest. I think it will be something big soon. Back to the topic. So in the tutorial, there is an example showing that you can use a "Update View" button to control when to trigger the data update. I want to implement this behavior in Html. Is this doable? 

Thanks!

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: How do you add an update button in html?
parts:
Yes. You can always see the HTML equivalent of any Shiny control by converting it to character and printing it at the console:


> cat(as.character(submitButton("Apply Changes")))
<div>
  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Apply Changes</button>
</div>
